basis: Systemic bacterial infection with direct platelet depletion; thrombocytopenia occurs in >50% of clinical cases. Hepatosplenomegaly alone does not establish organ dysfunction.

decisions.haematologic: involved: infection-associated platelet depletion is common (>50%), constituting direct blood-cell loss rather than organ enlargement alone.

basis: Brain, optic-nerve and pituitary abnormalities define septo-optic dysplasia. Digital skeletal malformations define this subtype; assigned involved because primary is capped at three.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: pituitary dysplasia/hormone deficiency is a core septo-optic dysplasia criterion, supported by the combined pituitary deficiency ancestor.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: digital skeletal malformations define this subtype; the three-primary-axis cap places this fourth defining axis here.

basis: Epileptic neurodevelopmental disorder; cleft palate, strabismus and conductive hearing loss each affect 1/3 reported patients. Recurrent infections alone do not establish immunodeficiency.

decisions.ocular: involved: persistent ocular alignment dysfunction (strabismus) is reported in 1/3 patients, meeting the frequency threshold in this small cohort.

basis: Inflammatory disease of the vertebral column; this nonspecific concept does not establish an infectious or autoimmune mechanism or common extra-spinal injury.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: inflammation alone does not establish infection, autoimmunity or another immune-mediated cause in this etiologically unspecified spinal disorder.

basis: Benign bone-forming neoplasm of the middle ear; both its ear location and skeletal tissue of origin are primary.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: an osteoma is a bone neoplasm; skeletal tissue of origin qualifies even when the lesion is localized to the middle ear.

basis: Bronchiectasis 7/10, ileitis 2/2 and vasculitis 2/2 support direct injury. Cap omits small-series skin/joint/thyroid findings; splenomegaly alone lacks blood-organ dysfunction.

decisions.haematologic: none: splenomegaly 6/6 does not establish blood-organ dysfunction; isolated lymphopenia 1/1 has weaker cohort support and is omitted under the cap.
decisions.cardiovascular: involved: vasculitis directly injures vessels and is reported in 2/2 assessed patients; retained for severity despite the small denominator.

basis: SLE: inflammatory arthritis ~80%, skin disease ~70%, nephritis ~30-50%. Cap omits common cytopenias in favor of severe renal injury; C4A-specific frequencies unavailable.

decisions.haematologic: none under cap: cytopenias occur in >50% of SLE, but arthritis, skin disease and potentially severe nephritis receive priority; C4A-specific rates unknown.
decisions.renal: involved: lupus nephritis directly damages kidneys in ~30-50% of SLE and is a major diagnostic domain; subtype-specific rates are unavailable.

basis: Neurodevelopmental disorder; hip dysplasia, hemivertebrae and clavicular pseudarthrosis each 1/2; astigmatism/hypermetropia each 1/2. GI symptoms alone do not establish injury.

decisions.ocular: involved: astigmatism and hypermetropia each occur in 1/2 reported patients and represent ocular refractive dysfunction; evidence is limited to a tiny cohort.

basis: Nutritional metabolic deficiency; dermatitis/alopecia are common (>30%) in overt disease. Direct neurologic injury in >=30% of nutritional cases is not established.

decisions.neurologic: none: neuropsychiatric complaints do not establish direct neurologic injury; neuropathy or other qualifying dysfunction lacks an established >=30% frequency in nutritional deficiency.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia, thickened skin and characteristic progressive valve disease are core diagnostic features. Respiratory insufficiency is 5/19 (<30%); hepatomegaly alone is not liver injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: characteristic progressive valvular disease is a major diagnostic feature of geleophysic dysplasia, not merely a minority complication.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: thickened skin is a defining feature of geleophysic dysplasia and belongs with its skeletal and cardiac diagnostic manifestations.
